products.name: Frontier Inference Clusters
products.description: Etched构建一类新的AI硬件：前沿推理集群，协同设计芯片、机架、软件和制造方法，使前沿模型在prefill和decode工作负载上实现最佳吞吐量、延迟、成本和能效。
products.target_customers: 大型AI公司、云服务提供商、超大规模计算服务商、量化交易公司
features: 支持长上下文和智能体工作负载

evidence_refs.quote: We're building a new category of AI hardware: frontier inference clusters. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing methods so frontier models can run with best-in-class throughput, latency, cost, and power efficiency for both prefill and decode workloads.

evidence_refs.quote: Etched is one of the very few independent companies still in business and offers complete frontier inference clusters rather than just individual chips; its approach is therefore more akin to what Nvidia refers to as AI factories than to that of traditional component suppliers.

investment_rationale.rationale: 电力可用性是数据中心选址的关键约束，ChronoCore™光传播速度比传统玻璃光纤快约47%，使分布式站点在相同延迟预算内可以相距更远，运营商可建设面积扩大一倍以上，且已部署并经过Prysmian等合作伙伴验证，订单量超出预期。
investment_rationale.quote: Power availability is the key constraint on data center placement. ChronoCore carries light roughly 47% faster than solid-core glass fibers, so distributed sites can sit that much farther apart within the same latency budget - more than doubling the area an operator can build in.
